title: feat(app-shell): each read-only base card on the Studio landing says how many items are customized and switched off
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb98azEtvfFx249GAG12Q2Q9)_

Fixes #28566

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 首页「已安装(只读)」区的每张基础包卡片多一行「已定制 n 项，已停用 m 项」(英文 "n customized, m switched off")。数字来自服务器的 `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations`,每张卡读一次;n = 服务器给的覆盖数 + 扩展数,m = 服务器给的停用数。有定制包(`BASE.custom`)时「已定制」链到它的 Studio,「已停用」链到基础包的自动化页。
- **为什么改**:管理员升级前、或平时想一眼看出改过哪些已安装应用、停用了什么(ADR-0146 D3)。之前首页卡片上没有任何计数,全局视图只有 Setup 的 Packaged automation 页,且只覆盖流程和动作。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只读展示一次已有接口;读取中不显示数字,读取失败显示灰色「无法读取定制」(悬停看服务器原话),绝不显示 0;可写包和定制包本身不画这一行、也不发请求。回滚即还原本 PR。注意:#28622 记录该接口在 main 上尚未挂载,挂载前这一行在真实环境里会显示「无法读取定制」。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packageCustomizations-io.ts`(读取与按 spec 校验)、`BuilderLanding.tsx` 的 `renderCustomizationLine`、`BuilderLanding.customizationCounts-28566.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.customizationCounts-28566.test.tsx`,预期 1 个文件、6 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **A small reader beside `packages-io`.** `packageCustomizations-io.ts` exports `fetchPackageCustomizationCounts(baseId)`. It sends `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations` and judges the dispatcher envelope's `data` by `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/api`. It returns `customized` = served `counts.overrides` + served `counts.extensions`, and `switchedOff` = served `counts.switchedOff`. It counts nothing itself. A failed read rejects with the server's sentence through `readEnvelopeFailureText`, the rule every package reader in that folder uses, else `HTTP STATUS`. An answer the schema refuses rejects too, so no number is ever read out of an off-contract body. A pair id (`isCustomizationPackage`) is refused before any request, because the route refuses it by shape.
- **The landing line.** `BuilderLanding` reads once per read-only base card drawn, after the package list answers. The effect is keyed on the joined target ids, a primitive (ui/AGENTS.md #10). The page does not wait for these reads. The line has three states:
  - pending: "Reading customizations…" with no number;
  - failed: a muted "Couldn’t read customizations", with the server's sentence as its `title`;
  - read: "n customized, m switched off".
  When the package list holds `BASE.custom` (from `customizationPackageId`), "n customized" links to `/studio/BASE.custom/data`. Otherwise it is plain text. "m switched off" links to `/studio/BASE/automations`, the pillar where the switch lives.
- **No line on a writable package or on a pair.** A pair served read-only is still a pair, so it gets no line either.
- **Strings.** Seven `engine.studio.landing.customizations.*` keys go into `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio namespace, in `en` and `zh`. The zh line reads 「已定制 n 项，已停用 m 项」, as the card asks. The other languages fall back to `en`, as the whole namespace does by design. Placeholders are `customized`, `switchedOff` and `pair`, single-brace `tFormat` tokens. There is no `count` token, so the i18next count-family gate does not apply.

## Tests

`BuilderLanding.customizationCounts-28566.test.tsx` runs the real landing and the real reader under a real router. Only the package list and `fetch` are stubbed, with answers shaped by the route's schema inside the dispatcher envelope. The six cases are the card's five plus one:

- 3 overrides, 1 extension and 2 switched off read "4 customized, 2 switched off". The pair link goes to `/studio/hotcrm.custom/data` and the switched-off link to `/studio/hotcrm/automations`. One request is sent, for the base only.
- A base with no pair reads "0 customized, 0 switched off" with no pair link.
- A failed read (503 with an error envelope) shows the failed state, no digit, and the server's sentence in the title.
- An answer the schema refuses (no `counts`) shows the failed state with no digit. This is the extra case.
- A writable package, a writable pair and a read-only pair draw no line and send no request.
- The landing paints while both reads stay pending, and both lines show no number.

Four existing landing tests (`accessibleNames-12510`, `orgScope-11553`, `recentPackages-11863`, `setupExit-12513`) draw a read-only card. The new read reached a real socket from them, and the ui network-escape guard refused it. They now mock the reader with a pending promise, the way they already mock `packages-io`. No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **#28622: the route is not mounted on `main` yet.** The seat reports that `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations` is in the route ledger but answers nothing at runtime. This PR builds against the declared schema with stubbed answers, as the card's Tests ask. Until #28622 lands, a live landing shows the failed state ("Couldn’t read customizations"), never a number. The seat holds landing until then. No server code is touched here.
- **Transport.** The reader uses `fetch` the way its neighbours in `packages-io.ts` do, so the landing uses one transport with one failure-text rule. `@objectstack/client`'s `packages.customizations(id)` exists. Moving every package reader in this folder onto the client would be a change of its own.
- **One read per card.** The route has no batched form, so the landing sends one read per read-only base drawn. There is no cap beyond the cards on the page.
